verdict.rationale: Attio's reporting page describes native in-app analysis of live data, including line charts, bar graphs and geospatial maps. It also says visualizations can be combined into dashboards and built collaboratively. It names pipeline and conversion reports such as weighted pipeline, pipeline by region, stuck deals, win rate, sales cycle and stage conversion, so no spreadsheet export is needed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on building reports (all evidence is marketing copy), explicit activity reporting (only a thin 'live data from every conversation' mention), clarity on which plans include 'Advanced reporting', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
